log: 📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 2). Cold smoking (under 90°F) preserves without cooking. Jerky done right lasts months.
📖 Your old life taught you things. 1 skill from your past — check your Journal.
Nothing here looks like home. You know none of these plants. Learn fast.
📖 Your hands remember: knap a Stone knife (stone + vine) — the oldest tool there is. Find the stone.
📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Sanne Vega. Baker. From Minneapolis, USA. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Dog tags, Dead Phone, Knife roll, Search locket, Trail compass. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. You heard it in the dark. Breathing. Not yours. It knew your name — it said it wrong, like it learned the shape of the sound but not what it meant.
A person, maybe 50s: "Don't bother picking around the tents. Walk out. The land feeds people who go looking."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.

It lowers its head. Paws the earth. This is the warning. There won't be another.
🐗 It moves.
You don't know what that was. something huge, rooting in the underbrush Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ SOMETHING HUGE, ROOTING IN THE UNDERBRUSH! You're on your own.
